_comment: Reference example only — files starting with '_' are skipped by the loader. mobIndex is a 3-digit hex string matching BG-wiki convention (e.g. '0x157'); use null when unknown so the relationship is preserved but the slot is unset. respawnTime is in seconds — for lottery NMs it's the window-open delay after PH ToD; for timed NMs it's the respawn timer; use null for popped/quest NMs that have no timer.
